comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (66.67%) to Bac7(1-23). P: 45%, R: 34%. GRAVY: -2.28; mol Wt: 3659.373; mol formula: C169H266N63O30; mol ex coeff: 5550. Activity: active against Gram- E. coli ML-35p or ATCC 25922 (MIC 1 uM), E. cloacae XDR CI 4172 (MIC 2 uM), A. baumannii XDR CI 2675 (MIC 8 uM), K. pneumoniae ATCC 700603 (MIC 2 uM), P. aeruginosa ATCC 27853 (MIC 8 uM), P. mirabilis XDR CI 3423 (MIC 2 uM), Gram+ M. luteus B-1314 (MIC 1 uM), B. subtilis B-886 (MIC 0.25 uM), M. phlei Ac-1291 (MIC 0.5 uM), S. aureus ATCC 6538P (MIC 2 uM), S.aureus ATCC 29213 (MIC>32 uM). In vitro toxicity: human RBC: HC50 > 128 uM; cytottoxicity: HaCaT: TC50 > 128 uM; HEK293T: TC50 128 uM. Animal model:mouse: septicemia model induced by E. coli ATCC 25922, i.p./i.p.x3, treatment at 1, 4, and 8 h post-infection at 10 mg/kg, 80% survival after 7 days. Recombinant production:bacteria:Escherichia coli: peptide was expressed and purified.
